title: Free speech group FIRE says DOJ and DHS will end efforts to curb "ICE Sightings - Chicagoland" Facebook group and Eyes Up iOS app, which report on ICE activity (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
summary: Kanishka Singh / Reuters: Free speech group FIRE says DOJ and DHS will end efforts to curb “ICE Sightings - Chicagoland” Facebook group and Eyes Up iOS app, which report on ICE activity — Free speech group FIRE said on Friday the US government agreed to end efforts to press Apple (AAPL.O) and Facebook …
